final:
-- Pure formatter: no capabilities, so it cannot reach fs or io.
format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() >= 3
  ex format_line("INFO", "ready") == "[INFO] ready"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

-- Prints one formatted line. Declares only io; fs is not granted.
log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  io.print(format_line(level: level, message: message))
